title: GitOps Configuration
description: Configuration for pulling symbol, config and lookup files from a remote source (GitHub repo or Kubernetes ConfigMap) to enable centralized configuration management

tenx.description: The target 10x pipeline to run (e.g., run, compile)

source.description: The source type for this include
The source type for this include

enabled.description: Controls whether to enable this pull config

token.description: Access token for accessing the GitHub repo. See https://docs.github.com/en/authentication/keeping-your-account-and-data-secure/managing-your-personal-access-tokens

repo.description: The GitHub user/repo from which to pull (e.g., 'owner/repo')

branch.description: Branch on repo. If null, uses the repo's default branch

paths.description: Glob patterns within 'repo' to pull and extract to a temp folder

syncInterval.description: Interval to check the remote branch for updates (e.g., '5min'). Set to null to disable sync

destination.description: Stable absolute folder the pulled content is mirrored into after the initial pull and after every sync (atomic per-file writes; mtime refreshed every sync). Lookup options such as rateReceiverLookupFile must target this folder, not the sha-addressed pull cache. Unset disables the mirror. Requires engine >= 1.1.69.

enabled.description: Controls whether to enable this pull config (K8S_ENABLED)

namespace.description: ConfigMap namespace; defaults to the pod's own namespace from the mounted service-account volume (K8S_NAMESPACE)

configMap.description: ConfigMap name to pull from (K8S_CONFIGMAP; default log10x-action-intent)

keys.description: Glob patterns over ConfigMap data + binaryData keys; only matching keys are written to disk

syncInterval.description: Poll interval, floored to 60s by the scheduler (K8S_SYNC_INTERVAL)

apiServer.description: kube-apiserver URL; default is the in-cluster service URL (K8S_API_SERVER)

tokenPath.description: Path to the projected service-account token (K8S_TOKEN_PATH)

caPath.description: Path to the service-account CA cert (K8S_CA_PATH)
